'''July 2001 Melbourne tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG continental qualifier held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 15 July 2001. [[Ronnie Wilcox]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2652">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-melbourne-australie-15-07-01d2652/ melbourne-australie-15-07-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 17 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-melbourne-australie-15-07-01d2652/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Ronnie Wilcox]]
